newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Motor to build 20 bln yen engine line - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Motor to build 20 bln yen engine line - paper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd will spend about 20 billion yen to build a new engine production line for luxury sedans, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Thursday.
Construction of the line will begin in mid-1999 and Nissan hopes to start operations in early 2000, the newspaper said.
The line will produce 2,000cc to 3,000cc V6 engines that will be lighter than existing engines due to increased aluminium content, Nihon Keizai said.
It added that the new line will initially produce about 10,000 engines per month, although Nissan may later raise that to 30,000.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
